name: Iberis Capital
facts: Broad tech: fintech, adtech, AI, health, space
position: Iberis Capital is a Portuguese venture-capital and private-equity manager with offices in Lisbon and Porto. It backs founders solving big problems through technology at every stage from pre-seed to Series E, and supports them on strategy, processes and team building as well as capital and network.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your portfolio covers almost every field I've worked in: fraud and identity (Feedzai, LOQR, Fraudio), ad tech (Mobrand, Primetag, Kevel, Frameplay) and conversational AI (Agentifai). That's rare, and it's why I'm writing to you first.
summary: Iberis supports its founders on strategy, processes and team building, which is precisely where a senior Product & RevOps operator plugs in. I've spent nine years in tech on B2B and B2C products: KYC and bot detection at 14M-user scale, a geofencing SDK for mobile apps, and customer and revenue operations for a New York ad platform. With fintech, ad tech and AI companies across every stage of your portfolio, I can help one company for a few months or several over time.

reasons.title: Fraud, identity and embedded finance
reasons.body: I owned KYC at Pi Network, scaling to 14M+ users with bot detection and silent bans. Feedzai, LOQR, Fraudio, Habit and Paynest live in that world.

reasons.title: Ad tech from both sides
reasons.body: I've worked on an ad platform (Vibe.co) and on the publisher side, helping start Pi Network's ad network. That's Mobrand, Primetag, Kevel, Frameplay and Mediaprobe.

reasons.title: The team-building part of your support
reasons.body: Iberis already helps founders with processes and team building. I can be the senior product or RevOps person you place with a founder, freelance or full-time, from Lisbon.

vc_notes.thesis: Broad tech with fintech, ad tech and AI well represented, all central to my track record.
vc_notes.stage: Pre-seed to Series E: every stage where product and RevOps work matters.
vc_notes.platform: Hands-on support on strategy, processes and team building.
